author: visegrad24
text:
A major coordinated sabotage attack was just carried out against railway infrastructure in at more than 20 locations in the Netherlands.

Large 2 meter-long metal pipes were deliberately attached to the tracks, triggering track-circuit and safety system failures by tricking the grid's computers into registering that the tracks were blocked. 

Some of the attacked railway lines include:

Amersfoort – Zwolle Zwolle – Leeuwarden
Utrecht – Arnhem
Arnhem – Zutphen
Amersfoort–Deventer
Gouda–Oudewater
